claims.summary: X_1..X_N i.i.d. uniform on [0,1]^2, Y evenly spread, W = 2^(-l_1), n_Q the counts of the cells of side W, D(G) = sum_Q G_Q (n_Q - N W^2), c_alpha(G) = sum_e W^2 psi*_alpha_d(e)(|Delta_e G|/W). (a) For alpha in [2,6)^2: if for some C, with probability tending to one, every grid function G on the mesh W with c_alpha(G) <= 2 has |D(G)| <= C sqrt(N log N), then conj:ultimate-matching holds at alpha with L = max(260, 4C). (b) At (4,4), the hypothesis of (a) follows, with C = C_0 e^22 + (C_1/2) C_2, from the bound C_2 sqrt(N log N) for every nested chain at the one height y* of thm:one-height-chain-reduction on the mesh W with sum_e W^2 psi_4^*(|Delta_e|/(2W)) <= 2. Conditional: no instance of either hypothesis is known.
claims.assessment: Working proof of a conditional statement, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_coarse_sufficiency_20261018/review.txt):thm:cell-scale-reduction at cell side W (a fixed beta in (3/4,1) with (beta - 1/2)(max alpha - 2) < 1 exists exactly when max alpha < 6); lem:grid-flow-duality (b) turns an edge flow with out theta_Q = N W^2 - n_Q into the coarse field, and its (d) at delta = W, lambda' = N/8 turns the flow's existence into D(G) <= (L/8) sqrt(N log N)(c_alpha(G) + 7) for every G, which the class bound gives by scaling when C <= L/4; part (b) is (a) composed with thm:one-height-chain-reduction's conclusion at the mesh W.
